name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, meaning all 130 GBP actions (including 2 calls, 96 directions, and 32 web clicks) are coming entirely from organic presence. The biggest movement is a 60.71% drop in GBP engagement over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced search demand or a dip in local ranking visibility with no paid traffic to compensate.

performance.verdict: GBP cliff is real; 4 overdue SOW blockers demand human escalation now.

findings.text: 3 CRM milestones overdue since July (1st Directives, Tom call list, dedup workbook); 342-stub blocker missed Aug-31 deadline — Sales-i pipeline blocked.
Web/SEO root-cause fix and AGS+Forte contact pull both missed Aug-31 deadline; 2 active blockers with no logged completion event.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for 4 consecutive days (Aug-31 through Sep-03), versus a prior-7d average of ~5.6 actions/day — sharpest cliff in the 45-day series.
GBP 7d engagement fell 60.71% vs prior 7d; 28-day total of 130 actions (only 2 calls) is the sole revenue-adjacent signal with zero paid amplification available.
GA4, Search Console, IG reach, and all paid channels read 0 for all 28 days — no web or social traffic data available to diagnose organic-to-site conversion.
